scientific.integrity: The primary full text was inspected at the dimensional model, scaled system, claimed disease-free equilibrium, next-generation matrices, threshold theorem, parameter table, and numerical reproduction numbers. The cited next-generation framework was inspected at its definitions, sign conditions, and threshold theorem. Exact rational arithmetic replays the numerical constants. Independent audit has not been performed.
scientific.limitations: The result corrects the disease-free state and linear invasion threshold of the printed deterministic equations. It does not reconstruct unpublished code, re-run the full numerical study, or claim that every downstream theorem is false.

title: Correct disease-free state and invasion threshold for a media-aware SQEIAR model
